representation: Block-mean downsample of the Indian-subset GeoTIFF to a 0.05-degree cell-centre grid stored as a compressed NumPy .npz (lat[500], lon[700], depth_m int16, negative = below sea level). A full-resolution PostGIS raster would use raster2pgsql; this MVP uses the sampled grid.
disclaimer: Supporting environmental layer only. NOT authoritative navigation / hydrographic data; do not use GEBCO alone for navigation-safety claims.
